purpose: The shared pieces of the Value card's lines: the line props, text and select editors that save on Enter or on leaving, the source control slot, the menu of qualifiers a level or meter has not set, the move button for older stored lists, and the host the lines read through.
namedChanges: Imports: `./PlanSource` is `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-plan-source`; `../../lib/base/planCard` is `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-plan-card-facts` (`planSourceEmpty`, `PlanSourceValue`); `../../lib/base/planValueModel` is `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-value-card-model` (`ValueCardData`, checked to be exported there); the `BaseRecord` type from `../../lib/base/records` is `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-base-record`.
`export` is put before each symbol the source did not export (everything above except `ValueLineProps` and `legacyMoveLabel`), as the line units import them. No other change in a symbol.

`src/host.ts` is new: `ValueLinesHost`, `ValueLinesHostContext`, `useValueLinesHost()`. Its members replace the app calls the lines made outside the units: the whole hook `useLinkLabel` (source lines 447-466, whose body is the reference host implementation in this README), `useShell().openOntologyConcept` (lines 1376, 1395), and `searchLiveTerms` and the type chooser's defaults (lines 1435, 1466). The line units call them: the Levels line `useLinkLabel`, the Endpoint line the others.
Comments: the names of people, the batch and cycle tags and the QA ids are removed, keeping the technical meaning (two batch tags in the comments of `ValueLineProps`).
`tsconfig.json` leaves out `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, which the app's source is not compiled with.
